verdict: e4b-v3 multi-task LoRA + anti-suppression instruction arm: every preregistered gate that gates PASSES and the ship rule is met - the v3 GGUF is a confirmed ship candidate. Run T: ladder gold_recoverable 1.0 vs 1.0 (T1a PASS; stale_leak regressed 0.0 -> 0.1, reported not gating, and STABLE at 0.1 across three fresh-container replicates - one pair at n=10); KU-oracle cortex 0.680 vs the deployed v2's 0.654 over 5 replicates each with judge std 0.0 (T1b PASS - the Opus claims-regen data IMPROVES claims, +0.026 cortex, +0.077 hybrid); quantity smoke clean (T2 PASS); capacity spot 14/18 of the Opus-covered instances, nearly double the >= 9 bar (T3 PASS). Run B (500 q, 8 arms, extractor = e4b-v3 both passes): gate 1 rag control EXACT zero (0/0 flips). Gate 2 claims-shift covariate +0.056 (p 0.0039, 58W/30L) - far beyond the 0.02 attribution bound, so per the preregistered branch the primary reads as a JOINT claims+events effect: the 4B student's claims bank now beats the qwen-27b bench extractor outright (hybrid 0.714 vs 0.658 pooled). Gate 3 primary: syn(v3 bank) 0.602 vs the committed evq-0806 syn 0.474 on multi-session - +0.128, p 0.0068, 27W/10L - PASS at p < 0.05, attribution joint per gate 2; the within-run events uplift is +0.038 (p 0.36) over an already-stronger hybrid, smaller than evq's +0.098 because the claims bank absorbed part of the headroom. Gate 4 ins arm: pooled no-harm PASS (+0.010); its ms delta +0.015 (p 0.72) misses the promotion bar, but it posts the run's best cells everywhere it matters - 0.764 pooled (best arm of any run in this series), 0.714 temporal-reasoning, 0.617 multi-session. Gate 5: tr non-inferiority +0.015 PASS, strong four -0.004 within margin PASS; the KU guard misses its 0.02 letter by 0.006 (hybrid KU 0.872 vs evq 0.897, p 0.74, 4W/6L = 2 questions of 78, statistically indistinguishable from noise) - recorded as a letter miss with a noise-consistent reading. Incidental harness finding, measured during the stale_leak replication: a WARM llama.cpp candidate container corrupts subsequent ladder passes (stale_leak 1.0 on passes 2-3 of a shared container vs 0.1 on every fresh-container pass) - all campaign numbers were fresh-container single-pass and are unaffected; ladder replication must restart the container per pass until the cache behavior is pinned down.

ship_rule: MET by the preregistered letter (T1-T3 pass, B1 valid, B3 passes) => the v3 GGUF ships on the user's go: HF upload, ops/Dockerfile.extractor MODEL_URL bump, deploy via ops/update.ps1, live-verify an extract through the sidecar. Chronicle stays default-off; the soak review owns defaults. Decision-relevant residuals for the ship call: (1) stale_leak 0.1 stable (one ladder pair; the KU path shows no stale symptom - cortex improved); (2) KU guard letter miss at noise level. The ins directive line does NOT ship (promotion bar not met) but is the series' nominal best arm and belongs in the next preregistration alongside the BEAM re-run's hdr case.
